test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT true regarding brain fingerprinting?

options.text: Brain fingerprinting is also known as Brain Electrical Oscillation Signature Profiling (BEOSP).
The test involves a question answer session with the accused.
The test is carried out by electroencephalogram, to study the electrical behaviour of the human brain.
Information or material discovered during the tests can be made part of the evidence.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The test involves a question answer session with the accused.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brain fingerprinting** is an objective, scientific method to detect concealed information stored in the brain by **measuring electroencephalographic (EEG) brain responses**, or brainwaves, non-invasively by sensors placed on the scalp.
 
• Brain fingerprinting is also known as **Brain Electrical Oscillation Signature Profiling (BEOSP).**
 
• Information or material discovered during the tests can be made part of the evidence.
 
• Brain fingerprinting (BF) detects concealed information stored in the** brain by measuring brainwaves. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• DNA fingerprinting is a technique to find out variations in individuals of a population at the DNA level.
 
• It works on the principle of polymorphism in DNA sequences.
 
• Polymorphisms are inheritable from parents to children, DNA fingerprinting is the basis of paternity testing, in case of disputes.
